rankedVisibleCriteria.outcome: Saturated blue/cyan stone, teal and purple coral retain palette family, with soft broad highlight-to-midtone transitions and readable material separation. Dark recesses are local purposeful depth; no broad black base band, muddy merged group or clipped white sparkle. Equal cardinal softness preserves rotatable-world neutrality.

The W/E interfaces carry one uninterrupted reef surface across repeated middle modules in all four facings. No exposed end face, alpha crack, dark/light stripe or crown step; strict native profile/normal/material evidence and real consumer previews establish this, without hidden overlap or image repair.

Selected larger coral openings, branches/cluster rhythm and crafted stone features enrich the reef while keeping primary silhouettes legible. Do not reward tiny noisy dots, uniform ornament coverage or target details that exceed clearance/port constraints.

Every required facing has coherent volume, generous readable separation and no dead side. No intersections/coplanar flashes, clipped crowns, artificial silhouette rim/glow, directional ground shadow or hidden camera-facing art.
